Package com.github.gumtreediff.matchers.optimal.rted

Class InfoTree

java.lang.Object
com.github.gumtreediff.matchers.optimal.rted.InfoTree
public class InfoTree extends Object
Stores all needed information about a single tree in several indeces.

  • Constructor Details

    • InfoTree

      public InfoTree(Tree aInputTree, LabelDictionary aLd)
      Creates an InfoTree object, gathers all information about aInputTree and stores in indexes. aInputTree is not needed any more. Remember to pass the same LabelDictionary object to both trees which are compared.
      Parameters:
      aInputTree - an LblTree object
      aLd - a LabelDictionary object

      public int[] getNodeRelSubtrees(int pathType, int nodePostorder)
